model: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL + shared-Q8_0 MTP
hardware: AMD Strix Halo gfx1151, 128 GB unified memory, TuneD accelerator-performance

baseline: v0.13.0 fcf8bf70 for prompt_lookup.final_v013; main f37fb012 for the earlier sections
method: HTTP gufo serve --sessions 1 --context 65536 --think off --speculative mtp; fresh server per run, one short greedy warm-up, then a fixed ordered request list (shallow, then 32K behind a shared ~30K-token repository-text prefix restored from the RAM cache). Rates are completion_tokens / usage.gufo.decode_ms; prefill and max inter-token gaps come from usage.gufo. Greedy: temperature 0. Sampled: temperature 1, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, seed 42; seeded texts differ between builds by design, so a 5-seed pooled pass (seeds 1-5) is reported separately.

final5.change: AppendLookup copies only when ExpectedCopies(match length, copies) exceeds the length controller's ExpectedDrafts over the MTP depths the copies would replace (rule of succession for copies; the controller's own per-depth acceptance estimates for MTP). Both are functions of committed tokens.

Both builds use 4 cycles with 20/20 drafts accepted
verdict.machine_state: RAM gate candidate: 120 flags, chiefly prefill/TTFT +5-53% on identical work (lookup does not run during prefill); the host-disk gate of the same suites raised 21, with flagged requests matching base within 0.2%
verdict.resolved_by_focused_reruns: long_cancel_resume decode (+9.7%/+6.0% in both gates, identical drafts and output) did not recur in either candidate rerun; thinking_tool_one_token and agent_open_schema flagged in one candidate rerun and in the unchanged-base control, and passed in the other candidate rerun
verdict.inconclusive: the gate has no clean candidate run: candidate reruns raised 21 and 6 flags, the unchanged-base control 18; startup 79-108 s and restart 26-74 s vary on both builds
verdict.storage: host-disk cache writes stall at ~18 MB/s on this 93%-full disk; the unchanged-base control failed thinking-tool-cancel-disk and disk-spacing-disk; restart_ms 25.7-41.7 s on base vs 40.7-73.7 s on the candidate across four disk runs; RAM-backed runs do not establish host-disk behavior
